info.title: API.SH: Ticketmaster
info.description: The Ticketmaster API from API.SH: public Ticketmaster data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.description: ISO time.

parameters.name: before

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

get.description:
An artist's or attraction's upcoming events (tour dates), 20 per page: title, start date, on-sale and presale windows, venue, status, seatmap image and url, with the artist's name, genre and total event count. Pass `q` (an artist name), `id` or `url`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ticketmaster-artist-events

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Artist or attraction name (1 more credit than passing an id or link).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Artist id (the number in the artist page url).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Artist page url (https://www.ticketmaster.com/<name>-tickets/artist/<id>).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1); `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

events.title: Trans-Siberian Orchestra - The Ghosts Of Christmas Eve
Trans-Siberian Orchestra - The Ghosts Of Christmas Eve

get.description:
Ticketmaster's segments (Music, Sports, Arts & Theater, Family) and their genres, each with its id and browse link (use the link with /ticketmaster/v1/events).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ticketmaster-categories

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: One segment (default all).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One event: name, start date and time zone, on-sale and presale windows, venue (address, coordinates), attractions, seatmap image, status (cancelled, postponed, rescheduled, sold out), category and url. Pass `q` to open the first current event matching a keyword (events expire, so this keeps a link working), or `id` / `url` of a specific event with its name in `q` when only an id is given.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 2 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ticketmaster-event

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Event or artist keywords; opens the best current match.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Event id (with `q` as the event name, or use `url`).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Event url (https://www.ticketmaster.com/<name>/event/<id>).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The events embedded in that page, each with presale windows (`presale_dates`), `category_id` and `end_utc` when the page carries them. Narrow to a date range with `start_date`/`end_date`. `next_cursor` is null.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ticketmaster-events

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Discovery URL or path, for example `/discover/concerts`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Only events from this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Only events up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
